prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a sideswipe while changing lanes. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1351; do not mention it.)
text:
I represent the individual injured in a motor vehicle collision that occurred when the other driver sideswiped our client while our client was changing lanes. Our client sustained injuries as a result of this incident and is currently receiving medical treatment.

Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly. If your insured or any representative of your company has been in contact with our client, please route any future inquiries through our firm.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability policy limits applicable to your insured, along with a certified copy of the declarations page and confirmation of any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply.

We also ask that your company preserve all evidence related to this collision. This includes the claim file, photographs, dash camera or telematics data, recorded statements, police reports, vehicle repair records, and any electronic data from the vehicles involved. Please ensure that this material is retained and not altered, discarded, or repaired without prior notice to this office.
